correctness.rationale: All ordinary derivations have the explicit exterior-square normal form. Evaluation at any element with nonzero generating-vector component is surjective via independent linear parameters, so the only locality constraint is on central bivectors. The decomposable tangent-preserver lemma forces the central action to lie in the image of the injective infinitesimal exterior-square representation for n>=3 in characteristic not two. The four-index coefficient relation proves the lemma; the n=3 case follows from the explicit trace-transpose isomorphism. Converse pointwise witnesses, parameter uniqueness and dimensions follow. Independent exact modular checks give 9/16/25/16 tangent solution dimensions and 2250 explicit witness verifications. The checker is finite corroboration, not the proof.

value.rationale: The free two-step nilpotent Lie algebra on n generators is a canonical family. Determining its complete algebraic reflexive hull of derivations is an intrinsic and motivated strengthening of the published existence theory. The independent two-endomorphism structure identifies exactly n^2 non-derivation directions in every free rank at least three; the semidirect Lie structure adds a natural representation-theoretic description. This is an entire infinite-family classification, not a single witness or a known-table restatement.
